About BlackRock MuniYield Quality Fund ( Free Report ) BlackRock MuniYield Quality Fund, Inc is a closed-end management investment company listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol MQY. The fund seeks to provide current income that is exempt from regular U.S. federal income tax by investing primarily in a portfolio of municipal obligations issued by states, territories, municipalities and other governmental entities.

The fund generally invests in longer-term municipal bonds and may allocate assets across various sectors of the municipal market, including essential-service areas such as education, health care, transportation, utilities and public infrastructure.
